epic.title: Prior Authorization Status Tracker
epic.summary: Submit and track prior authorizations from the provider portal over FHIR PAS with an X12 278 fallback.
epic.approach: Model PAS resources first, then freeze contracts so the payer integration, status service and portal UI build in parallel. Deadline rules run beside the service, and verification proves both the FHIR and X12 paths with synthetic cases.

brief: Providers need to see where each prior authorization stands without calling the payer. Submit PA requests from the portal using FHIR PAS, track status live, fall back to X12 278 for payers without FHIR, and keep an audit trail that meets HIPAA and CMS-0057-F decision timelines.

requirements.text: Submit a PA request from the portal as a FHIR PAS Claim bundle ($submit).
Route each request to FHIR PAS or X12 278 based on payer capability.
Send X12 278 requests through the clearinghouse for payers without FHIR.
Track status (pended, approved, denied, more info) via $inquire polling.
Status tracker screen with filters by payer, status, provider and due date.
Notify providers in-app and by email when a status changes.
Attach additional documentation when the payer requests more information.
Write an audit event for every PHI access and status change.
Alert before CMS-0057-F decision deadlines (72 h expedited, 7 days standard).
Retry payer timeouts idempotently without duplicate submissions.
Only the patient's care team can view a PA request.
Status API p95 under 300 ms at 200 requests per second.
Show denial reason codes with plain-language explanations.

questions.q: Which clearinghouse handles X12 278 for non-FHIR payers?
questions.proposed: Use the existing clearinghouse contract; no new vendor.

questions.q: Is polling acceptable, or must status use FHIR Subscriptions?
questions.proposed: Poll every 15 minutes now; add Subscriptions when payers support them.

questions.q: Which document types can providers attach?
questions.proposed: PDF and images up to 20 MB, sent as DocumentReference.

questions.q: Do email notifications include patient details?
questions.proposed: No PHI in email; link back to the portal.

success: 12 of 12 synthetic PA cases reach a final status on both FHIR and X12 paths
Status visible in the portal within 60 s of a payer update
Deadline alerts fire 12 h before CMS-0057-F limits
Every PHI access writes an audit event
Zero high or critical security findings at release
All 14 requirements trace to passing tests
